es.L: He aquí, todas las almas son {{deity_pronoun:mías|Mías}}; como el alma del padre, así el alma del hijo, {{deity_pronoun:mías|Mías}} son. El alma que peque, esa morirá.
es.B: Toda vida {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece, tanto la vida del padre como la del hijo; ambas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen. La persona que peca es la que morirá.
es.R: Todas las personas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen, tanto los padres como los hijos. La persona que peca es la que morirá.

decisions.choice: the soul: the living person, a whole human life
alternatives: the soul as the part of a person that lives on after death
decisions.reason: The word *nefesh* means a living being, a person, or a life. Here it does not mean a soul as distinct from the body, but the person as a whole: every human life belongs to God. "The soul who sins" means the person who sins.

decisions.choice: the person who sins will die: each is judged for their own sin
decisions.reason: This is the answer to the proverb of verse 2. The Law already said that parents are not put to death for their children's sins nor children for their parents' (Deuteronomy 24:16). "Die" and "live" here are about the LORD's judgment: whether a person is condemned or spared and keeps their place among his people (verses 9, 13, 21). The chapter does not deny that sin harms the next generation (compare Exodus 20:5); it denies that anyone is condemned for sins they did not commit.

decisions.choice: the soul (L); the person (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *nefesh* in this verse and verse 20. Literal keeps the traditional "soul"; Balanced and Readable say "person", which is what the word means here (m1).

decisions.choice: parent, child (with father, son as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: Here the father and son stand for every parent and child, so Balanced and Readable use the gender setting, as Jeremiah 31:29 does. In the case of verses 5-18 the Hebrew describes a man, his son and his grandson, and there the words stay as they are.

decisions.choice: ’l’âme’ (L); ’la personne’ (B, R) for nefesh in 18:4 and 18:20
decisions.reason: The book’s term list: the word means the living person (m1), which Balanced and Readable say as the English does; Literal keeps ’l’âme’, feminine, so ’c’est elle qui mourra’.

decisions.choice: ’du parent’ / ’du père’ and ’de l’enfant’ / ’du fils’ (B) under the gender setting, with the article inside the span
decisions.reason: French ’de l’enfant’ and ’du fils’ differ in their article, so the span holds the whole phrase, as the English holds ’parent’ and ’child’.

decisions.choice: "영혼" (L), "사람" (B, R) for nefesh; "목숨" (B) where it is each one's life
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for 18:4 and 18:20; the shared footnote says nefesh is the living person, not a soul apart from the body.

decisions.choice: {{gender:부모|아버지}} and {{gender:자식|아들}} where the English has parent/father and child/son spans
decisions.reason: Korean has both wordings, so it keeps the English setting; Literal keeps 아버지 and 아들 as the Hebrew has them.

decisions.choice: "el alma que peque, esa morirá" (L); "la persona que peca es la que morirá" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nefesh in 18:4 and 18:20 as the terms note sets it.

source.text: וְאִ֖ישׁ כִּי־יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man, if he is righteous and does justice and righteousness,

en.L: And if a man is righteous and does justice and righteousness,
en.B: Suppose there is a man who is righteous and does what is just and right,
en.R: Suppose there is a man who is righteous. He does what is fair and right.

fr.L: Et si un homme est juste et pratique le droit et la justice,
fr.B: Supposons un homme qui soit juste et qui pratique le droit et la justice,
fr.R: Supposons qu’un homme soit juste. Il fait ce qui est équitable et juste.

ko.L: 어떤 사람이 의로워서 정의와 의를 행한다고 하자.
ko.B: 어떤 사람이 의로워서 정의와 의를 행한다고 하자.
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 의롭다고 하자. 그는 공정하고 옳은 일을 한다.

es.L: Y si un hombre es justo y practica el derecho y la justicia,
es.B: Supongamos que hay un hombre justo, que hace lo que es justo y recto,
es.R: Supongamos que hay un hombre justo. Hace lo que es justo y correcto.

decisions.choice: if a man is righteous: the first of three cases, set out like the cases in the Law
decisions.reason: The chapter tells of three generations: a righteous man (verses 5-9), his violent son (verses 10-13), and that son's son, who does not follow his father's ways (verses 14-18). The form is that of the Law's case laws ("if a man ...", Exodus 21; Leviticus 20). The cases are about men because some of the laws named (verses 6, 11, 15) concern a man and his neighbor's wife; the principle applies to every person (verses 4, 20).

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness: what is fair and right
decisions.reason: The pair describes a life lived by God's standards toward God and toward others (Genesis 18:19; Amos 5:24). Verses 6-9 list what it means.

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness (L); what is just and right (B); what is fair and right (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two nouns. Balanced and Readable use the adjectives, which read more naturally after "does".

decisions.choice: ’le droit et la justice’ (L, B); ’ce qui est équitable et juste’ (R) for mishpat and tsedaqah
decisions.reason: As the prophets’ term list for the pair, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "정의와 의" (L, B), "공정하고 옳은 일" (R) for mishpat and tsedaqah
decisions.reason: The Isaiah-Jeremiah note's pair, as Isaiah 9:6; R gives the plain sense, as the English R "fair and right".

decisions.choice: "el derecho y la justicia" (L); "lo que es justo y recto" (B); "lo que es justo y correcto" (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat and tsedaqah as the terms note sets them, kept through the chapter.

source.text: אֶל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־אֵ֤שֶׁת רֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ לֹ֣א טִמֵּ֔א וְאֶל־אִשָּׁ֥ה נִדָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יִקְרָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: on the mountains he has not eaten, and his eyes he has not lifted to the idols of the house of Israel, and his neighbor's wife he has not defiled, and to a woman in impurity he has not come near,

en.L: [if] he has not eaten on the mountains, and has not lifted up his eyes to the filthy idols of the house of Israel, and has not defiled his neighbor's wife, and has not come near a woman in [her] impurity,
en.B: who does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel, who does not defile his neighbor's wife or have relations with a woman during her period,
en.R: He does not eat at the mountain shrines. He does not look to the idols of the people of Israel for help. He does not commit adultery with his neighbor's wife. He does not have sex with a woman during her monthly period.

fr.L: [s’]il n’a pas mangé sur les montagnes, et n’a pas levé les yeux vers les idoles immondes de la maison d’Israël, et n’a pas souillé la femme de son prochain, et ne s’est pas approché d’une femme pendant [son] impureté,
fr.B: qui ne mange pas dans les sanctuaires des montagnes et ne se tourne pas vers les idoles de la maison d’Israël, qui ne souille pas la femme de son prochain et n’a pas de relations avec une femme pendant ses règles,
fr.R: Il ne mange pas dans les sanctuaires des montagnes. Il ne compte pas sur les idoles du peuple d’Israël pour l’aider. Il ne commet pas d’adultère avec la femme de son voisin. Il n’a pas de relations sexuelles avec une femme pendant ses règles.

ko.L: 그가 산 위에서 [제물을] 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 집의 더러운 우상들에게 눈을 들지 않으며, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히지 않고, 월경 중인 여자를 가까이하지 않으며,
ko.B: 그는 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 집의 우상들을 바라보지 않으며, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히지 않고, 월경 중인 여자와 잠자리를 같이하지 않는다.
ko.R: 그는 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹지 않는다. 그는 이스라엘 백성의 우상들에게 도움을 구하지 않는다. 그는 이웃의 아내와 간음하지 않는다. 그는 월경 중인 여자와 잠자리를 같이하지 않는다.

es.L: [si] no ha comido sobre los montes, ni ha alzado sus ojos a los ídolos inmundos de la casa de Israel, ni ha deshonrado a la mujer de su prójimo, ni se ha acercado a una mujer en [su] impureza,
es.B: que no come en los santuarios de los montes ni pone los ojos en los ídolos de la casa de Israel, que no deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo ni tiene relaciones con una mujer durante su menstruación,
es.R: No come en los santuarios de los montes. No busca la ayuda de los ídolos del pueblo de Israel. No comete adulterio con la mujer de su prójimo. No tiene relaciones sexuales con una mujer durante su período mensual.

decisions.choice: eaten on the mountains: eaten sacrificial meals at the hill shrines of other gods
decisions.reason: Sacrifices at the high places were followed by a meal, and to eat it was to take part in the worship (22:9; Hosea 4:13).

decisions.choice: lifted his eyes to the idols: looked to them in worship and for help
decisions.reason: To lift one's eyes to someone is to look to them for help (Psalm 121:1; 123:1). The idols are *gillulim* (see 6:4).

decisions.choice: his neighbor's wife ... a woman in her impurity: the laws of Leviticus
decisions.reason: Adultery with a neighbor's wife and relations with a woman during her monthly period were both forbidden (Leviticus 18:19-20; 20:10, 18). "Come near" is a polite way of speaking of sexual relations.

decisions.choice: filthy idols (L); idols (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *gillulim*.

decisions.choice: have relations with a woman during her period (B); have sex with a woman during her monthly period (R)
alternatives: come near a woman in her impurity
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's polite expression. Balanced and Readable state its meaning plainly, as the decision at 16:1 sets out for frank passages.

decisions.choice: "durante su menstruación" (B); "durante su período mensual" (R)
decisions.reason: Said plainly and soberly, as in the Spanish of 22:10.

source.text: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א יוֹנֶ֔ה חֲבֹלָת֥וֹ חוֹב֙ יָשִׁ֔יב גְּזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א יִגְזֹ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב יִתֵּ֔ן וְעֵירֹ֖ם יְכַסֶּה־בָּֽגֶד׃

records.literal_gloss: and no one he oppresses, his pledge for a debt he returns, robbery he does not commit, his bread to the hungry he gives, and the naked he covers with clothing,

en.L: and has not oppressed anyone, has returned to the debtor his pledge, has committed no robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing,
en.B: who does not oppress anyone but returns what a debtor gave him as a pledge, who does not rob but gives his food to the hungry and clothes the naked,
en.R: He does not take advantage of anyone. When someone gives him something to keep as a promise to pay back a loan, he returns it. He does not rob anyone. He gives food to hungry people and clothes to people who have nothing to wear.

fr.L: et n’a opprimé personne, a rendu au débiteur son gage, n’a pas commis de vol, a donné son pain à l’affamé et couvert de vêtements celui qui est nu,
fr.B: qui n’opprime personne mais rend à son débiteur ce qu’il a reçu en gage, qui ne vole pas mais donne sa nourriture à l’affamé et habille celui qui est nu,
fr.R: Il ne profite de personne. Quand quelqu’un lui laisse un objet pour promettre de rembourser un prêt, il le lui rend. Il ne vole personne. Il donne à manger à ceux qui ont faim et des vêtements à ceux qui n’ont rien à se mettre.

ko.L: 아무도 억압하지 않고, 빚진 자의 담보물을 돌려주며, 강도질하지 않고, 굶주린 자에게 자기 빵을 주며, 헐벗은 자에게 옷을 입혀 주고,
ko.B: 그는 아무도 억압하지 않고, 빚진 사람에게서 잡은 담보물을 돌려주며, 남의 것을 빼앗지 않고, 굶주린 사람에게 자기 음식을 나누어 주며, 헐벗은 사람에게 옷을 입혀 준다.
ko.R: 그는 아무도 괴롭히지 않는다. 누가 돈을 꾸면서 갚겠다는 약속으로 물건을 맡기면, 그것을 돌려준다. 그는 남의 것을 빼앗지 않는다. 그는 굶주린 사람에게 먹을 것을 주고, 입을 것이 없는 사람에게 옷을 준다.

es.L: y no ha oprimido a nadie, ha devuelto al deudor su prenda, no ha cometido robo, ha dado su pan al hambriento y ha cubierto con ropa al desnudo,
es.B: que no oprime a nadie, sino que devuelve al deudor lo que le dio en prenda, que no roba, sino que da su comida al hambriento y viste al desnudo,
es.R: No se aprovecha de nadie. Cuando alguien le deja algo como garantía de que pagará un préstamo, se lo devuelve. No roba a nadie. Da comida a los que tienen hambre y ropa a los que no tienen qué ponerse.

decisions.choice: returns the debtor's pledge: the law of pledges
decisions.reason: A lender could take a pledge, such as a cloak, as security for a loan, but the Law required him to give back a cloak by nightfall, since the poor man had nothing else to sleep in (Exodus 22:25-26; Deuteronomy 24:10-13).

decisions.choice: gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked: care for the poor
decisions.reason: Isaiah 58:7 names the same deeds as the fasting the LORD wants.

source.text: בַּנֶּ֣שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־יִתֵּ֗ן וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔ח מֵעָ֖וֶל יָשִׁ֣יב יָד֑וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: at interest he does not lend, and profit he does not take, from injustice he turns back his hand, justice of truth he does between man and man,

en.L: has not lent at interest or taken profit, has turned back his hand from injustice, has done true justice between one person and another,
en.B: who does not lend at interest or take profit, who keeps his hand from wrongdoing and judges fairly between one person and another,
en.R: He does not charge interest when he lends money, and he does not make a profit from it. He keeps away from doing wrong. He is fair when he settles disputes between people.

fr.L: n’a pas prêté à intérêt ni pris d’usure, a détourné sa main de l’injustice, a rendu un jugement vrai entre un homme et un autre,
fr.B: qui ne prête pas à intérêt et ne prend pas d’usure, qui détourne sa main du mal et juge équitablement entre les gens,
fr.R: Il ne demande pas d’intérêt quand il prête de l’argent, et il ne s’enrichit pas sur le dos des autres. Il se tient loin du mal. Il est juste quand il règle les disputes entre les gens.

ko.L: 이자를 받고 꾸어 주지 않으며 이익을 챙기지 않고, 불의에서 손을 거두며, 사람과 사람 사이에 참된 공의로 재판하고,
ko.B: 그는 이자를 받고 돈을 꾸어 주지 않고 이익을 챙기지 않으며, 악한 일에서 손을 떼고, 사람들 사이의 다툼을 공정하게 판가름해 준다.
ko.R: 그는 돈을 꾸어 줄 때 이자를 받지 않고, 그것으로 이익을 남기지 않는다. 그는 나쁜 일을 멀리한다. 그는 사람들 사이의 다툼을 공정하게 해결해 준다.

es.L: no ha prestado con interés ni ha cobrado usura, ha retirado su mano de la injusticia, ha hecho juicio verdadero entre hombre y hombre,
es.B: que no presta con interés ni cobra usura, que aparta su mano de la maldad y juzga con justicia entre una persona y otra,
es.R: No cobra intereses cuando presta dinero, ni saca ganancias de ello. Se aparta de hacer el mal. Es justo cuando resuelve pleitos entre la gente.

decisions.choice: interest and profit: the laws against making money from a needy neighbor
decisions.reason: The Law forbade an Israelite to charge interest on a loan to a fellow Israelite in need, whether in money or in food (Leviticus 25:35-37; Exodus 22:24). The two words may be two kinds of interest, or interest taken in advance and added at repayment.

decisions.choice: true justice between one person and another: fair judgment in disputes
decisions.reason: The phrase may describe a judge, or anyone called on to settle a quarrel (Zechariah 7:9).

source.text: בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֧י יְהַלֵּ֛ךְ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י שָׁמַ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֱמֶ֑ת צַדִּ֥יק הוּא֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: in my statutes he walks and my judgments he keeps, to do faithfulness — righteous he [is]; he will surely live, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: [if] he walks in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and keeps {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments, acting faithfully, he [is] righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: and who follows {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and keeps {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings faithfully. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He lives by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and is careful to obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rules. A man like that is righteous. He will certainly live, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: [s’]il marche dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et garde {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements, en agissant avec fidélité, il [est] juste ; il vivra certainement, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: et qui suit {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et observe fidèlement {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ordonnances. Cet homme est juste ; il vivra certainement, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il vit selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et fait attention à obéir à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles. Un tel homme est juste. Il vivra, c’est certain, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 내 규례를 따라 걷고 내 법도를 지켜 신실하게 행한다면, 그는 의인이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그는 내 규례를 따르고 내 법도를 성실하게 지킨다. 그런 사람이 의인이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 그는 내 법대로 살고 내 규칙을 잘 지킨다. 그런 사람은 의롭다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

es.L: [si] anda en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y guarda {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} decretos, actuando con fidelidad, ese [es] justo; ciertamente vivirá, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: y que sigue {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y cumple fielmente {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas. Ese hombre es justo; ciertamente vivirá, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Vive según {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y obedece con cuidado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas. Un hombre así es justo. Ciertamente vivirá, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

decisions.choice: he is righteous; he will surely live: the verdict on the case
decisions.reason: The words sound like the verdict of a priest or judge (compare Leviticus 18:5). To "live" is to be accepted by the LORD and to escape the judgment that is coming.

decisions.choice: statutes, judgments (L); statutes, rulings (B); laws, rules (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording in Ezekiel for *chuqqot* ("statutes" / "statutes" / "laws") and *mishpatim* ("judgments" / "rulings" / "rules"), as published in chapters 1-7.

decisions.choice: ’prescriptions’, ’jugements’ (L); ’prescriptions’, ’ordonnances’ (B); ’lois’, ’règles’ (R) for chuqqot and mishpatim, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The book’s term list, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: ’il vivra certainement’
decisions.reason: The doubled Hebrew verb is an emphasis; French gives it with an adverb.

decisions.choice: "규례" (L, B), "법" (R) for chuqqot; "법도" (L, B), "규칙" (R) for mishpatim
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, as the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: Balanced ends the description of verses 6-8 in full sentences and starts the verdict here
decisions.reason: Korean cannot carry one conditional clause across four verses at Balanced; each verse is a closed sentence, and Literal keeps the long "if" sentence that ends here.

decisions.choice: "estatutos ... decretos" (L); "estatutos ... normas" (B); "leyes ... normas" (R)
decisions.reason: Chuqqot and mishpatim as the terms note sets them for Ezekiel, kept through the chapter.

source.text: וְהוֹלִ֥יד בֵּן־פָּרִ֖יץ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ דָּ֑ם וְעָ֣שָׂה אָ֔ח מֵאַחַ֖ד מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [if] he fathers a son, violent, a shedder of blood, and he does [to a brother] any one of these,

en.L: But [if] he fathers a son who is violent, a shedder of blood, who does any one of these [things],
en.B: But suppose he has a son who is violent, who sheds blood and does any of these things,
en.R: But suppose this man has a son who is violent and kills people. He does these evil things,

fr.L: Mais [s’]il engendre un fils violent, qui verse le sang, qui fait l’une de ces [choses],
fr.B: Mais supposons qu’il ait un fils violent, qui verse le sang et fait l’une de ces choses,
fr.R: Mais supposons que cet homme ait un fils violent, qui tue des gens. Il fait ces choses mauvaises,

ko.L: 그러나 그가 아들을 낳았는데, [그 아들이] 난폭하여 피를 흘리고, 이런 일 가운데 하나라도 저지른다면,
ko.B: 그런데 그에게 아들이 있어, 그 아들이 난폭하여 피를 흘리고 이런 악한 일 가운데 어떤 것을 한다고 하자.
ko.R: 그런데 이 사람에게 아들이 있다고 하자. 그 아들은 난폭하여 사람을 죽이고, 이런 악한 일들을 한다.

es.L: Pero [si] engendra un hijo violento, derramador de sangre, que hace cualquiera de estas [cosas],
es.B: Pero supongamos que tiene un hijo violento, que derrama sangre y hace cualquiera de estas cosas,
es.R: Pero supongamos que este hombre tiene un hijo violento que mata a la gente. Hace estas cosas malas,

decisions.choice: does any one of these: the son does the evil deeds that the father avoided
alternatives: does to a brother any of these
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is awkward. It may mean "any one of these things", or, with a small change, "to a brother any of these things". Either way the son does the wrongs listed in verses 11-13.

source.text: וְה֕וּא אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ אָכַ֔ל וְאֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ טִמֵּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: and he himself all these did not do, but also on the mountains he has eaten, and his neighbor's wife he has defiled,

en.L: though he himself did none of these [things], who even eats on the mountains and defiles his neighbor's wife,
en.B: though the father himself did none of them. This son eats at the mountain shrines, defiles his neighbor's wife,
en.R: though his father did none of them. The son eats at the mountain shrines. He commits adultery with his neighbor's wife.

fr.L: alors que lui-même n’a fait aucune de ces [choses], [un fils] qui mange même sur les montagnes et souille la femme de son prochain,
fr.B: alors que le père lui-même n’en a fait aucune. Ce fils mange dans les sanctuaires des montagnes, souille la femme de son prochain,
fr.R: alors que son père n’en a fait aucune. Le fils mange dans les sanctuaires des montagnes. Il commet l’adultère avec la femme de son voisin.

ko.L: 그 자신은 이 모든 일 가운데 아무것도 하지 않았는데, [그 아들은] 산 위에서 [제물을] 먹고, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히며,
ko.B: 아버지는 이런 일을 하나도 하지 않았는데, 이 아들은 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹고, 이웃의 아내를 더럽힌다.
ko.R: 그의 아버지는 이런 일을 하나도 하지 않았다. 그러나 아들은 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹는다. 그는 이웃의 아내와 간음한다.

es.L: aunque él mismo no hizo ninguna de estas [cosas], que incluso come sobre los montes y deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo,
es.B: aunque el padre no hizo ninguna de ellas. Este hijo come en los santuarios de los montes, deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo,
es.R: aunque su padre no hizo ninguna de ellas. El hijo come en los santuarios de los montes. Comete adulterio con la mujer de su prójimo.

decisions.choice: he himself did none of these: the father did none of these evil things
alternatives: the son did none of the good things
decisions.reason: The words are short. They can mean that the father did none of these evil things, or that the son did none of the good things the father did. Either way the contrast is between the two.

decisions.choice: the father (B); his father (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the father, following the first reading (m1), and name "this son" as the one who does the evil.

source.text: עָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנָ֔ה גְּזֵל֣וֹת גָּזָ֔ל חֲבֹ֖ל לֹ֣א יָשִׁ֑יב וְאֶל־הַגִּלּוּלִים֙ נָשָׂ֣א עֵינָ֔יו תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] poor and needy he has oppressed, robberies he has committed, a pledge he does not return, and to the idols he has lifted his eyes, abomination he has done,

en.L: has oppressed the poor and needy, has committed robbery, has not returned a pledge, has lifted his eyes to the filthy idols, has done abomination,
en.B: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not return what was pledged, looks to the idols, does detestable things,
en.R: He takes advantage of poor and needy people. He robs people. He does not give back what was given him as a promise to pay. He looks to idols for help, and he does disgusting things.

fr.L: opprime le pauvre et l’indigent, commet des vols, ne rend pas le gage, lève les yeux vers les idoles immondes, commet l’abomination,
fr.B: opprime le pauvre et l’indigent, commet des vols, ne rend pas ce qu’on lui a laissé en gage, se tourne vers les idoles, fait des choses détestables,
fr.R: Il profite des pauvres et des gens dans le besoin. Il vole les gens. Il ne rend pas ce qu’on lui a laissé pour promettre de payer. Il compte sur les idoles pour l’aider, et il fait des choses dégoûtantes.

ko.L: 가난하고 궁핍한 자를 억압하고, 강도질하며, 담보물을 돌려주지 않고, 더러운 우상들에게 눈을 들며, 가증한 일을 행하고,
ko.B: 그는 가난하고 궁핍한 사람을 억압하고, 남의 것을 빼앗으며, 담보물을 돌려주지 않고, 우상들을 바라보며, 역겨운 짓을 한다.
ko.R: 그는 가난하고 어려운 사람들을 괴롭힌다. 그는 남의 것을 빼앗는다. 그는 빚을 갚겠다는 약속으로 맡은 물건을 돌려주지 않는다. 그는 우상들에게 도움을 구하고, 역겨운 일을 한다.

es.L: oprime al pobre y al necesitado, comete robos, no devuelve la prenda, alza sus ojos a los ídolos inmundos, hace abominación,
es.B: oprime al pobre y al necesitado, comete robos, no devuelve lo que recibió en prenda, pone los ojos en los ídolos, hace cosas detestables,
es.R: Se aprovecha de los pobres y de los necesitados. Roba a la gente. No devuelve lo que le dejaron como garantía de pago. Busca la ayuda de los ídolos, y hace cosas repugnantes.

decisions.choice: filthy idols, abomination (L); idols, detestable things (B); idols, disgusting things (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *gillulim* and *to'evah*.

source.text: בַּנֶּ֧שֶׁךְ נָתַ֛ן וְתַרְבִּ֥ית לָקַ֖ח וָחָ֑י לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־הַתּוֹעֵב֤וֹת הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת דָּמָ֖יו בּ֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: at interest he has lent and profit he has taken — will he live? He will not live! All these abominations he has done; he will surely be put to death; his blood will be on him.

en.L: has lent at interest and taken profit; will he then live? He will not live! He has done all these abominations; he will surely be put to death; his blood will be on him.
en.B: and lends at interest and takes profit. Will such a man live? He will not live! He has done all these detestable things; he will surely be put to death. His blood will be on his own head.
en.R: He charges interest when he lends money, and he makes a profit from it. Will a man like that live? No, he will not! He has done all these disgusting things, so he must die. It will be his own fault.

fr.L: prête à intérêt et prend de l’usure : vivrait-il ? Il ne vivra pas ! Il a commis toutes ces abominations ; il sera certainement mis à mort ; son sang sera sur lui.
fr.B: prête à intérêt et prend de l’usure. Un tel homme vivra-t-il ? Il ne vivra pas ! Il a commis toutes ces choses détestables ; il sera certainement mis à mort. Son sang retombera sur sa propre tête.
fr.R: Il demande des intérêts quand il prête de l’argent, et il s’enrichit sur le dos des autres. Un tel homme vivra-t-il ? Non ! Il a fait toutes ces choses dégoûtantes, alors il doit mourir. Ce sera de sa propre faute.

ko.L: 이자를 받고 꾸어 주며 이익을 챙긴다면, 그가 살겠느냐? 그는 살지 못할 것이다! 그가 이 모든 가증한 일을 했으니, 그는 반드시 죽임을 당할 것이다. 그의 피가 그에게로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 이자를 받고 돈을 꾸어 주며 이익을 챙긴다. 이런 사람이 살겠느냐? 살지 못할 것이다! 그가 이 모든 역겨운 짓을 했으니, 반드시 죽임을 당할 것이다. 그가 죽는 책임은 그 자신에게 있다.
ko.R: 그는 돈을 꾸어 주고 이자를 받아 이익을 남긴다. 이런 사람이 살겠느냐? 아니다, 살지 못할 것이다! 그가 이 모든 역겨운 일을 했으니, 그는 죽어야 한다. 그것은 그 자신의 탓이다.

es.L: presta con interés y cobra usura; ¿vivirá entonces? ¡No vivirá! Ha hecho todas estas abominaciones; ciertamente morirá; su sangre será sobre él.
es.B: y presta con interés y cobra usura. ¿Vivirá un hombre así? ¡No vivirá! Ha hecho todas estas cosas detestables; ciertamente morirá. Su sangre caerá sobre su propia cabeza.
es.R: Cobra intereses cuando presta dinero, y saca ganancias de ello. ¿Vivirá un hombre así? ¡No! Ha hecho todas estas cosas repugnantes, así que tiene que morir. Será culpa suya.

decisions.choice: his blood will be on him: he is responsible for his own death
decisions.reason: The phrase is used in the Law for a person who deserves death; no one else bears the guilt for it (Leviticus 20:9-13).

decisions.choice: he will surely be put to death: the formula of the Law for a capital crime
decisions.reason: The words are those of the death penalty in the Law (Exodus 21:12-17). Here they announce the LORD's judgment.

decisions.choice: It will be his own fault
alternatives: his blood will be on him
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the idiom (m1).

decisions.choice: "그가 죽는 책임은 그 자신에게 있다" (B) for "his blood will be on him"
decisions.reason: Korean has no idiom of blood on the head; Literal keeps the image, Balanced states the sense the shared decision gives, and R says "his own fault" as the English R.

source.text: וְהִנֵּה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וַיַּ֕רְא אֶת־כָּל־חַטֹּ֥את אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּרְאֶ֕ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כָּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, he fathers a son, and he sees all the sins of his father that he did, and he sees and does not do like them,

en.L: But look, [if] he fathers a son who sees all the sins that his father did, and he sees and does not do likewise,
en.B: But suppose this man in turn has a son, and the son sees all the sins his father has committed, and though he sees them, he does not do the same,
en.R: But suppose this man has a son. The son sees all the sins his father has committed. He thinks about them, but he does not do the same things.

fr.L: Mais voici, [s’]il engendre un fils qui voit tous les péchés que son père a commis, et qui [les] voit et ne fait pas de même,
fr.B: Mais supposons que cet homme ait à son tour un fils, et que ce fils voie tous les péchés commis par son père ; il les voit, mais il ne fait pas de même,
fr.R: Mais supposons que cet homme ait un fils. Le fils voit tous les péchés que son père a commis. Il y réfléchit, mais il ne fait pas les mêmes choses.

ko.L: 그러나 보아라, 그가 아들을 낳았는데, [그 아들이] 자기 아버지가 저지른 모든 죄를 보고, 보고서도 그와 같이 하지 않는다면,
ko.B: 그런데 이 사람에게도 아들이 있는데, 그 아들은 자기 아버지가 저지른 모든 죄를 보고, 보고 나서도 그대로 따라 하지 않는다고 하자.
ko.R: 그런데 이 사람에게도 아들이 있다고 하자. 그 아들은 자기 아버지가 지은 모든 죄를 본다. 그는 그것을 곰곰이 생각하고, 아버지처럼 하지 않는다.

es.L: Pero he aquí, [si] engendra un hijo que ve todos los pecados que hizo su padre, y [los] ve y no hace cosa semejante,
es.B: Pero supongamos que este a su vez tiene un hijo, y el hijo ve todos los pecados que su padre ha cometido, y aunque los ve, no hace lo mismo,
es.R: Pero supongamos que este hombre tiene un hijo. El hijo ve todos los pecados que su padre ha cometido. Piensa en ellos, pero no hace lo mismo.

decisions.choice: he sees: he considers and takes warning
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats "he sees". With different vowels the second could be read "he fears", and some ancient translations seem to have read it that way. The repetition stresses that he looks hard at his father's life and chooses another way.

decisions.choice: He thinks about them
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the second "sees" (m1).

source.text: עַל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ לֹ֥א טִמֵּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: on the mountains he has not eaten, and his eyes he has not lifted to the idols of the house of Israel, his neighbor's wife he has not defiled,

en.L: he has not eaten on the mountains, nor lifted his eyes to the filthy idols of the house of Israel, nor defiled his neighbor's wife,
en.B: who does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel, who does not defile his neighbor's wife,
en.R: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the people of Israel for help. He does not commit adultery with his neighbor's wife.

fr.L: il n’a pas mangé sur les montagnes, il n’a pas levé les yeux vers les idoles immondes de la maison d’Israël, il n’a pas souillé la femme de son prochain,
fr.B: qui ne mange pas dans les sanctuaires des montagnes et ne se tourne pas vers les idoles de la maison d’Israël, qui ne souille pas la femme de son prochain,
fr.R: Il ne mange pas dans les sanctuaires des montagnes et ne compte pas sur les idoles du peuple d’Israël pour l’aider. Il ne commet pas d’adultère avec la femme de son voisin.

ko.L: 산 위에서 [제물을] 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 집의 더러운 우상들에게 눈을 들지 않으며, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히지 않고,
ko.B: 그는 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 집의 우상들을 바라보지 않으며, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히지 않는다.
ko.R: 그는 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 백성의 우상들에게 도움을 구하지 않는다. 그는 이웃의 아내와 간음하지 않는다.

es.L: no ha comido sobre los montes, ni ha alzado sus ojos a los ídolos inmundos de la casa de Israel, ni ha deshonrado a la mujer de su prójimo,
es.B: que no come en los santuarios de los montes ni pone los ojos en los ídolos de la casa de Israel, que no deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo,
es.R: No come en los santuarios de los montes ni busca la ayuda de los ídolos del pueblo de Israel. No comete adulterio con la mujer de su prójimo.

decisions.choice: the same list as verse 6
decisions.reason: The grandson keeps the same laws as his grandfather (verse 6). The law about a woman's monthly period is not repeated here.

source.text: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א הוֹנָ֔ה חֲבֹל֙ לֹ֣א חָבָ֔ל וּגְזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א גָזָ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב נָתָ֔ן וְעֵר֖וֹם כִּסָּה־בָֽגֶד׃

records.literal_gloss: and no one he has oppressed, a pledge he has not taken, and robbery he has not committed; his bread to the hungry he has given, and the naked he has covered with clothing,

en.L: has not oppressed anyone, has not taken a pledge, has committed no robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing,
en.B: who does not oppress anyone or demand a pledge, who does not rob but gives his food to the hungry and clothes the naked,
en.R: He does not take advantage of anyone or demand something as a promise to pay back a loan. He does not rob anyone. He gives food to hungry people and clothes to people who have nothing to wear.

fr.L: n’a opprimé personne, n’a pas pris de gage, n’a pas commis de vol, a donné son pain à l’affamé et couvert de vêtements celui qui est nu,
fr.B: qui n’opprime personne et n’exige pas de gage, qui ne vole pas mais donne sa nourriture à l’affamé et habille celui qui est nu,
fr.R: Il ne profite de personne et n’exige rien pour garantir le remboursement d’un prêt. Il ne vole personne. Il donne à manger à ceux qui ont faim et des vêtements à ceux qui n’ont rien à se mettre.

ko.L: 아무도 억압하지 않고, 담보물을 잡지 않으며, 강도질하지 않고, 굶주린 자에게 자기 빵을 주며, 헐벗은 자에게 옷을 입혀 주고,
ko.B: 그는 아무도 억압하지 않고 담보물을 잡지 않으며, 남의 것을 빼앗지 않고, 굶주린 사람에게 자기 음식을 나누어 주며, 헐벗은 사람에게 옷을 입혀 준다.
ko.R: 그는 아무도 괴롭히지 않고, 돈을 꾸어 줄 때 갚겠다는 약속으로 물건을 맡으라고 하지도 않는다. 그는 남의 것을 빼앗지 않는다. 그는 굶주린 사람에게 먹을 것을 주고, 입을 것이 없는 사람에게 옷을 준다.

es.L: no ha oprimido a nadie, no ha tomado prenda, no ha cometido robo, ha dado su pan al hambriento y ha cubierto con ropa al desnudo,
es.B: que no oprime a nadie ni exige prenda, que no roba, sino que da su comida al hambriento y viste al desnudo,
es.R: No se aprovecha de nadie ni exige nada como garantía de que le pagarán un préstamo. No roba a nadie. Da comida a los que tienen hambre y ropa a los que no tienen qué ponerse.

decisions.choice: has not taken a pledge: he goes beyond returning it
decisions.reason: In verse 7 the righteous man returns a pledge; here the grandson does not even take one.

source.text: מֵעָנִ֞י הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ נֶ֤שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א לָקָ֔ח מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י עָשָׂ֔ה בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֖י הָלָ֑ךְ ה֗וּא לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת בַּעֲוֺ֥ן אָבִ֖יו חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: from the poor he has turned back his hand, interest and profit he has not taken; my judgments he has done, in my statutes he has walked — he will not die for the iniquity of his father; he will surely live.

en.L: has turned back his hand from the poor, has not taken interest or profit, has done {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments [and] walked in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes, he will not die for the iniquity of his father; he will surely live.
en.B: who keeps his hand from harming the poor and takes no interest or profit, who obeys {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings and follows {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes. He will not die for his father's guilt; he will surely live.
en.R: He does not harm poor people. He does not charge interest or make a profit from loans. He obeys {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rules and lives by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws. That man will not die because of his father's sins. He will certainly live.

fr.L: a détourné sa main du pauvre, n’a pris ni intérêt ni usure, a pratiqué {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements [et] a marché dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions, celui-là ne mourra pas pour l’iniquité de son père ; il vivra certainement.
fr.B: qui se garde de faire du tort au pauvre et ne prend ni intérêt ni usure, qui observe {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ordonnances et suit {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions : celui-là ne mourra pas pour la faute de son père ; il vivra certainement.
fr.R: Il ne fait pas de tort aux pauvres. Il ne demande pas d’intérêts et ne s’enrichit pas avec ses prêts. Il obéit à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles et vit selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois. Cet homme-là ne mourra pas à cause des péchés de son père. Il vivra, c’est certain.

ko.L: 가난한 자에게서 손을 거두고, 이자나 이익을 받지 않으며, 내 법도를 행하고 내 규례를 따라 걷는다면, 그는 자기 아버지의 죄악 때문에 죽지 않을 것이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 가난한 사람을 해치지 않고, 이자나 이익을 받지 않으며, 내 법도를 지키고 내 규례를 따른다. 그는 자기 아버지의 죄 때문에 죽지 않을 것이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 가난한 사람들을 해치지 않는다. 그는 돈을 꾸어 주고 이자를 받거나 이익을 남기지 않는다. 그는 내 규칙을 지키고 내 법대로 산다. 그런 사람은 자기 아버지의 죄 때문에 죽지 않을 것이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다.

es.L: ha retirado su mano del pobre, no ha cobrado interés ni usura, ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} decretos [y] ha andado en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos; no morirá por la iniquidad de su padre; ciertamente vivirá.
es.B: que aparta su mano para no dañar al pobre y no cobra interés ni usura, que cumple {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas y sigue {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos. Ese no morirá por la culpa de su padre; ciertamente vivirá.
es.R: No hace daño a los pobres. No cobra intereses ni saca ganancias de los préstamos. Obedece {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas y vive según {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes. Ese hombre no morirá por los pecados de su padre. Ciertamente vivirá.

decisions.choice: from the poor
decisions.reason: The Septuagint reads "from injustice", as in verse 8. The Hebrew "from the poor" means that he keeps his hand from harming them.

decisions.choice: he will not die for the iniquity of his father: the answer to the proverb
decisions.reason: Here the principle of verse 4 is applied to the grandson: his father's sins do not condemn him.

decisions.choice: iniquity (L); guilt (B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *'awon*.

source.text: אָבִ֞יו כִּֽי־עָ֣שַׁק עֹ֗שֶׁק גָּזַל֙ גֵּ֣זֶל אָ֔ח וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ט֛וֹב עָשָׂ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמָּ֑יו וְהִנֵּה־מֵ֖ת בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: His father, because he practiced extortion, robbed [his] brother of robbery, and what is not good he did among his people — look, he will die for his iniquity.

en.L: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, committed robbery against a brother, and did what is not good among his people, look, he will die for his iniquity.
en.B: But as for his father, he will die for his own guilt, because he extorted from others, robbed his brother and did what was not good among his people.
en.R: But his father will die for his own sins, because he cheated people, robbed his brother and did evil among his people.

fr.L: Son père, parce qu’il a pratiqué l’extorsion, commis des vols envers [son] frère et fait ce qui n’est pas bien au milieu de son peuple, voici, il mourra pour son iniquité.
fr.B: Mais son père, lui, mourra pour sa propre faute, parce qu’il a extorqué les autres, volé son frère et fait ce qui n’est pas bien au milieu de son peuple.
fr.R: Mais son père mourra pour ses propres péchés, parce qu’il a escroqué les gens, volé son frère et fait le mal au milieu de son peuple.

ko.L: 그의 아버지로 말하자면, 그가 남을 억눌러 빼앗고, 형제의 것을 강탈하며, 자기 백성 가운데서 좋지 않은 일을 했으니, 보아라, 그는 자기 죄악 때문에 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그의 아버지는 남을 억눌러 빼앗고, 형제의 것을 강탈하며, 자기 백성 가운데서 좋지 않은 일을 했으니, 자기 죄 때문에 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그의 아버지는 자기 죄 때문에 죽을 것이다. 그는 사람들을 속여 빼앗고, 자기 동족의 것을 강탈하고, 자기 백성 가운데서 악한 일을 했다.

es.L: En cuanto a su padre, por cuanto hizo extorsión, despojó a [su] hermano y no hizo lo bueno en medio de su pueblo, he aquí, morirá por su iniquidad.
es.B: Pero en cuanto a su padre, morirá por su propia culpa, porque extorsionó a otros, robó a su hermano e hizo lo que no es bueno en medio de su pueblo.
es.R: Pero su padre morirá por sus propios pecados, porque estafó a la gente, robó a su hermano e hizo el mal en medio de su pueblo.

decisions.choice: a brother: a fellow Israelite
decisions.reason: "Brother" here can mean a member of the same people, not only of the same family (Leviticus 25:35-36).

source.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַדֻּ֛עַ לֹא־נָשָׂ֥א הַבֵּ֖ן בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֑ב וְהַבֵּ֞ן מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־חֻקּוֹתַ֥י שָׁמַ֛ר וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you say, Why does the son not bear the iniquity of the father? The son has done justice and righteousness, all my statutes he has kept and done them; he will surely live.

en.L: Yet you say, "Why does the son not bear the iniquity of the father?" The son has done justice and righteousness; he has kept all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and done them; he will surely live.
en.B: Yet you ask, "Why should the son not share the guilt of his father?" The son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes, so he will surely live.
en.R: But you ask, "Why should the son not be punished for his father's sins?" The son has done what is fair and right. He has carefully obeyed all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws, so he will certainly live.

fr.L: Et vous dites : « Pourquoi le fils ne porte-t-il pas l’iniquité du père ? » Le fils a pratiqué le droit et la justice, il a gardé toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et les a mises en pratique ; il vivra certainement.
fr.B: Et vous demandez : « Pourquoi le fils ne partagerait-il pas la faute de son père ? » Le fils a pratiqué le droit et la justice et a veillé à observer toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions : il vivra certainement.
fr.R: Mais vous demandez : « Pourquoi le fils ne serait-il pas puni pour les péchés de son père ? » Le fils a fait ce qui est équitable et juste. Il a obéi avec soin à toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois, alors il vivra, c’est certain.

ko.L: 그런데 너희는 "어찌하여 아들이 아버지의 죄악을 짊어지지 않느냐?" 하고 말한다. 아들은 정의와 의를 행하고 내 모든 규례를 지켜 행했으니, 그는 반드시 살 것이다.
ko.B: 그런데도 너희는 "어찌하여 아들이 아버지의 죄를 함께 짊어지지 않느냐?" 하고 묻는다. 아들은 정의와 의를 행하고 내 모든 규례를 성실하게 지켰으니, 반드시 살 것이다.
ko.R: 그런데도 너희는 "어찌하여 아들이 아버지의 죄 때문에 벌을 받지 않느냐?" 하고 묻는다. 아들은 공정하고 옳은 일을 했다. 그는 내 모든 법을 잘 지켰다. 그러니 그는 반드시 살 것이다.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «¿Por qué no lleva el hijo la iniquidad del padre?». El hijo ha practicado el derecho y la justicia; ha guardado todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y los ha cumplido; ciertamente vivirá.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿Por qué no ha de cargar el hijo con la culpa de su padre?». El hijo ha hecho lo que es justo y recto y ha cuidado de cumplir todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos; por eso, ciertamente vivirá.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿Por qué no ha de ser castigado el hijo por los pecados de su padre?». El hijo ha hecho lo que es justo y correcto. Ha obedecido con cuidado todas {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes, así que ciertamente vivirá.

decisions.choice: why does the son not bear the iniquity of the father: the hearers' objection
decisions.reason: The exiles expected sons to share their fathers' punishment, as the proverb of verse 2 assumes. The LORD answers with the case he has just described.

decisions.choice: bear the iniquity: carry the guilt and its punishment
decisions.reason: To bear someone's iniquity is to suffer the punishment due for it (Leviticus 5:1; Numbers 14:33-34).

source.text: הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א׀בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֗ב וְאָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הַבֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַצַּדִּיק֙ עָלָ֣יו תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְרִשְׁעַ֥ת הָרָשָׁ֖ע עָלָ֥יו תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: The soul who sins, it will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous on him will be, and the wickedness of the wicked on him will be.

en.L: The soul who sins, it will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous will be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked will be upon him.
en.B: The person who sins is the one who will die. A {{gender:child|son}} will not share the guilt of a {{gender:parent|father}}, and a {{gender:parent|father}} will not share the guilt of a {{gender:child|son}}. The righteousness of the righteous will be their own, and the wickedness of the wicked will be their own.
en.R: The person who sins is the one who will die. {{gender:Children|Sons}} will not be punished for their {{gender:parents'|fathers'}} sins, and {{gender:parents|fathers}} will not be punished for their {{gender:children's|sons'}} sins. Good people will be rewarded for the good they do, and evil people will be punished for the evil they do.

fr.L: L’âme qui pèche, c’est elle qui mourra. Le fils ne portera pas l’iniquité du père, et le père ne portera pas l’iniquité du fils. La justice du juste sera sur lui, et la méchanceté du méchant sera sur lui.
fr.B: La personne qui pèche, c’est elle qui mourra. Un {{gender:enfant|fils}} ne partagera pas la faute d’un {{gender:parent|père}}, et un {{gender:parent|père}} ne partagera pas la faute d’un {{gender:enfant|fils}}. La justice du juste lui appartiendra, et la méchanceté du méchant lui appartiendra.
fr.R: La personne qui pèche, c’est elle qui mourra. Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} ne seront pas punis pour les péchés de leurs {{gender:parents|pères}}, et les {{gender:parents|pères}} ne seront pas punis pour les péchés de leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}}. Celui qui fait le bien sera récompensé pour le bien qu’il fait, et celui qui fait le mal sera puni pour le mal qu’il fait.

ko.L: 죄를 짓는 그 영혼이 죽을 것이다. 아들은 아버지의 죄악을 짊어지지 않고, 아버지도 아들의 죄악을 짊어지지 않을 것이다. 의인의 의도 자기에게로 돌아가고, 악인의 악도 자기에게로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.B: 죄를 짓는 그 사람이 죽을 것이다. {{gender:자식|아들}}이 {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 죄를 함께 짊어지지 않고, {{gender:부모|아버지}}도 {{gender:자식|아들}}의 죄를 함께 짊어지지 않을 것이다. 의인의 의는 그 자신의 것이 되고, 악인의 악도 그 자신의 것이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 죄를 짓는 바로 그 사람이 죽을 것이다. {{gender:자식|아들}}은 {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 죄 때문에 벌을 받지 않고, {{gender:부모|아버지}}도 {{gender:자식|아들}}의 죄 때문에 벌을 받지 않을 것이다. 착한 사람은 자기가 한 착한 일로 상을 받고, 악한 사람은 자기가 한 악한 일로 벌을 받을 것이다.

es.L: El alma que peque, esa morirá. El hijo no llevará la iniquidad del padre, ni el padre llevará la iniquidad del hijo. La justicia del justo será sobre él, y la maldad del malvado será sobre él.
es.B: La persona que peca es la que morirá. El hijo no cargará con la culpa del padre, ni el padre cargará con la culpa del hijo. La justicia del justo será suya, y la maldad del malvado será suya.
es.R: La persona que peca es la que morirá. Los hijos no serán castigados por los pecados de sus padres, ni los padres serán castigados por los pecados de sus hijos. Los buenos recibirán la recompensa del bien que hacen, y los malos recibirán el castigo del mal que hacen.

decisions.choice: a son will not bear the iniquity of the father: the law of Deuteronomy 24:16
decisions.reason: The Law says that parents shall not be put to death for their children, nor children for their parents; each is to die for their own sin (Deuteronomy 24:16; compare 2 Kings 14:6).

decisions.choice: the soul: the person, as in verse 4
decisions.reason: See verse 4.

decisions.choice: the soul (L); the person (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *nefesh* here, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: child, parent (B); children, parents (R), with son and father as the alternatives
decisions.reason: Here the principle covers every parent and child, so the gender setting is used, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: will be rewarded for the good they do ... will be punished for the evil they do
decisions.reason: "Will be on him" means that each person receives what their own conduct deserves. Readable says so plainly.

decisions.choice: The gender spans are worded so that one particle fits both options ("{{gender:자식|아들}}이" reads 자식이 or 아들이; "…은", "…의", "…도" likewise)
decisions.reason: 자식 and 아들 both end in a consonant, and 부모 / 아버지 take only particles that fit a vowel (의, 도), so each option reads correctly.

source.text: וְהָרָשָׁ֗ע כִּ֤י יָשׁוּב֙ מִכָּל־חַטֹּאתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַר֙ אֶת־כָּל־חֻקּוֹתַ֔י וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה חָיֹ֥ה יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the wicked, if he turns from all his sins that he has done, and keeps all my statutes and does justice and righteousness, he will surely live; he will not die.

en.L: But the wicked [person], if he turns from all his sins that he has done and keeps all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and does justice and righteousness, he will surely live; he will not die.
en.B: But if wicked people turn away from all the sins they have committed, keep all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and do what is just and right, they will surely live; they will not die.
en.R: But suppose evil people stop doing all the sins they have been doing. They obey all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and do what is fair and right. Then they will certainly live. They will not die.

fr.L: Mais le méchant, s’il se détourne de tous ses péchés qu’il a commis, s’il garde toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et pratique le droit et la justice, il vivra certainement ; il ne mourra pas.
fr.B: Mais si le méchant se détourne de tous les péchés qu’il a commis, s’il observe toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et pratique le droit et la justice, il vivra certainement ; il ne mourra pas.
fr.R: Mais supposons que le méchant arrête de commettre tous les péchés qu’il commettait. Il obéit à toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et fait ce qui est équitable et juste. Alors il vivra, c’est certain. Il ne mourra pas.

ko.L: 그러나 악인이 자기가 저지른 모든 죄에서 돌이켜 내 모든 규례를 지키고 정의와 의를 행하면, 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 그는 죽지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 악한 사람이라도 자기가 지은 모든 죄에서 돌이켜 내 모든 규례를 지키고 정의와 의를 행하면, 반드시 살 것이다. 죽지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 악한 사람이라도 지금까지 짓던 모든 죄를 그만두었다고 하자. 그리고 내 모든 법을 지키고 공정하고 옳은 일을 한다고 하자. 그러면 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 죽지 않을 것이다.

es.L: Pero el malvado, si se aparta de todos sus pecados que ha cometido, y guarda todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos, y practica el derecho y la justicia, ciertamente vivirá; no morirá.
es.B: Pero si los malvados se apartan de todos los pecados que han cometido, cumplen todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y hacen lo que es justo y recto, ciertamente vivirán; no morirán.
es.R: Pero supongamos que los malvados dejan de cometer todos los pecados que han estado cometiendo. Obedecen todas {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y hacen lo que es justo y correcto. Entonces ciertamente vivirán. No morirán.

decisions.choice: if the wicked turns: a person's past does not seal their fate
decisions.reason: The chapter now turns from the generations to a single life. As a son is not condemned for his father, so a person is not held to their own past if they turn from it.

decisions.choice: wicked people ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses "he" for any person. Balanced and Readable use "people" and "they", which include everyone, as the Hebrew means. Literal keeps the singular "he" of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: ’le méchant … il’ in the singular, as the Hebrew, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable turn the Hebrew singular into a plural to be inclusive; French ’le méchant … il’ is already generic, so French keeps the Hebrew’s number (see 13:22).

decisions.choice: The generic wicked person is singular ("악인이", "악한 사람이라도") with no gender span, where the English B and R turn to "people ... they"
decisions.reason: Korean 사람 and an unstated subject already include men and women, so the singular of the Hebrew needs no span and no plural.

source.text: כָּל־פְּשָׁעָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ל֑וֹ בְּצִדְקָת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יִֽחְיֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: All his transgressions that he has done will not be remembered against him; for his righteousness that he has done he will live.

en.L: All his transgressions that he has committed will not be remembered against him; because of his righteousness that he has done, he will live.
en.B: None of the rebellious acts they have committed will be remembered against them. Because of the righteousness they have practiced, they will live.
en.R: None of the sins they have committed will be held against them. They will live because they have done what is right.

fr.L: Aucune de ses transgressions qu’il a commises ne sera rappelée contre lui ; à cause de sa justice qu’il a pratiquée, il vivra.
fr.B: Aucun des actes de rébellion qu’il a commis ne sera retenu contre lui. À cause de la justice qu’il a pratiquée, il vivra.
fr.R: Aucun des péchés qu’il a commis ne sera retenu contre lui. Il vivra parce qu’il a fait ce qui est juste.

ko.L: 그가 저지른 모든 반역이 그에게 기억되지 않을 것이다. 그가 행한 그의 의 때문에 그는 살 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 저지른 모든 반역은 다시 기억되지 않을 것이다. 그가 행한 의 때문에 그는 살 것이다.
ko.R: 그가 지은 모든 죄를 내가 따지지 않을 것이다. 그가 옳은 일을 했으니 그는 살 것이다.

es.L: Ninguna de las transgresiones que cometió le será recordada; por la justicia que hizo vivirá.
es.B: Ninguno de los delitos que han cometido se les tendrá en cuenta. Vivirán por la justicia que han practicado.
es.R: Ninguno de los pecados que cometieron se les tomará en cuenta. Vivirán porque han hecho lo que es correcto.

decisions.choice: will not be remembered: will not be held against him
decisions.reason: For God to "remember" sins is to act on them in judgment (Hosea 8:13). Their past is no longer counted (compare Isaiah 43:25).

decisions.choice: transgressions (L); rebellious acts (B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *pesha'*.

source.text: הֶחָפֹ֤ץ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ מ֣וֹת רָשָׁ֔ע נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֲל֛וֹא בְּשׁוּב֥וֹ מִדְּרָכָ֖יו וְחָיָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Do I really take pleasure in [the] death of [the] wicked, declares [the] Lord Yahweh, [and] not in his turning from his ways so that he lives?

en.L: Do I indeed take pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, and not in his turning from his ways so that he may live?
en.B: Is it any pleasure to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} when the wicked die? declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. Would I not rather that they turn from their ways and live?
en.R: Do you think I am happy when evil people die? says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. No! I want them to turn away from their evil ways and live.

fr.L: Est-ce que vraiment je prends plaisir à la mort du méchant, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, et non à ce qu’il se détourne de ses voies et qu’il vive ?
fr.B: La mort du méchant {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fait-elle plaisir, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ? Ne voudrais-je pas plutôt qu’il se détourne de sa conduite et qu’il vive ?
fr.R: Croyez-vous que je suis content quand les méchants meurent, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ? Non ! Je veux qu’ils abandonnent leur mauvaise conduite et qu’ils vivent.

ko.L: 내가 정말 악인이 죽는 것을 기뻐하겠느냐? 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그가 자기 길에서 돌이켜 사는 것을 [기뻐하지] 않겠느냐?
ko.B: 내가 악인이 죽는 것을 조금이라도 기뻐하겠느냐? 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 오히려 그가 자기 길에서 돌이켜 사는 것을 기뻐하지 않겠느냐?
ko.R: 너희는 악한 사람이 죽을 때 내가 기뻐한다고 생각하느냐? 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 아니다! 나는 그가 악한 길에서 돌이켜 살기를 바란다.

es.L: ¿Acaso me complazco yo en la muerte del malvado?, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¿No [me complazco más bien] en que se aparte de sus caminos y viva?
es.B: ¿Acaso {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada que mueran los malvados?, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¿No preferiría yo que se aparten de sus caminos y vivan?
es.R: ¿Creen que yo me alegro cuando mueren los malvados?, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¡No! Lo que quiero es que dejen sus malos caminos y vivan.

decisions.choice: the LORD takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked: he wants them to turn and live
decisions.reason: This is the heart of the chapter, repeated in verse 32 and 33:11. The LORD's judgment is real, but his desire is for the wicked to turn. Compare 1 Timothy 2:4 and 2 Peter 3:9.

decisions.choice: the question closed before the formula ("?, declara"), and its second half asked again
decisions.reason: Spanish closes a question before the inserted formula, as in Jeremiah 3:1, so the Hebrew's one question is written as two.

source.text: וּבְשׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִצִּדְקָתוֹ֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל כְּכֹ֨ל הַתּוֹעֵב֜וֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֧ה הָרָשָׁ֛ע יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה וָחָ֑י כָּל־צִדְקֹתָ֤יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה בְּמַעֲל֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר־מָעַ֛ל וּבְחַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־חָטָ֖א בָּ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: And when the righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice, according to all the abominations that the wicked does he does — will he live? All his righteous deeds that he has done will not be remembered; for his unfaithfulness that he has committed and for his sin that he has sinned, for them he will die.

en.L: But when a righteous [person] turns away from his righteousness and does injustice, according to all the abominations that the wicked [person] does, will he live? All his righteous deeds that he has done will not be remembered; for his unfaithfulness that he has committed and for his sin that he has sinned, for them he will die.
en.B: But if righteous people turn away from their righteousness and do wrong, committing all the same detestable things that the wicked do, will they live? None of the righteous things they have done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness they are guilty of and the sins they have committed, they will die.
en.R: But suppose good people stop doing what is right and start doing wrong. They do the same disgusting things that evil people do. Will they live? No! None of the good things they did will be remembered. They will die because they were unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and committed sins.

fr.L: Mais quand le juste se détourne de sa justice et commet l’injustice, selon toutes les abominations que commet le méchant, vivra-t-il ? Toutes ses œuvres justes qu’il a faites ne seront pas rappelées ; à cause de son infidélité qu’il a commise et de son péché qu’il a péché, à cause d’eux il mourra.
fr.B: Mais si le juste se détourne de sa justice et fait le mal, en commettant toutes les choses détestables que fait le méchant, vivra-t-il ? On ne se souviendra d’aucune des actions justes qu’il a faites. À cause de l’infidélité dont il s’est rendu coupable et des péchés qu’il a commis, il mourra.
fr.R: Mais supposons que celui qui est bon arrête de faire ce qui est juste et commence à faire le mal. Il fait les mêmes choses dégoûtantes que les méchants. Vivra-t-il ? Non ! On ne se souviendra d’aucune des bonnes choses qu’il a faites. Il mourra, parce qu’il {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a été infidèle et qu’il a commis des péchés.

ko.L: 그러나 의인이 자기의 의에서 돌이켜 불의를 행하고, 악인이 행하는 모든 가증한 일대로 행한다면, 그가 살겠느냐? 그가 행한 모든 의로운 일은 기억되지 않을 것이다. 그가 저지른 배신과 그가 지은 죄 때문에, 그것들 때문에 그는 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 의인이라도 자기의 의에서 돌이켜 악을 행하고, 악인이 하는 온갖 역겨운 짓을 똑같이 한다면, 그가 살겠느냐? 그가 행한 의로운 일은 하나도 기억되지 않을 것이다. 그가 저지른 배신과 그가 지은 죄 때문에 그는 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 착한 사람이 옳은 일을 그만두고 악한 일을 하기 시작했다고 하자. 그가 악한 사람들이 하는 역겨운 일을 똑같이 한다. 그런 사람이 살겠느냐? 아니다! 그가 했던 착한 일은 하나도 기억되지 않을 것이다. 그는 나를 배신하고 죄를 지었기 때문에 죽을 것이다.

es.L: Pero si el justo se aparta de su justicia y hace injusticia, conforme a todas las abominaciones que hace el malvado, ¿vivirá? Ninguna de las obras justas que hizo será recordada; por la infidelidad que cometió y por el pecado que cometió, por ellos morirá.
es.B: Pero si los justos se apartan de su justicia y hacen el mal, cometiendo las mismas cosas detestables que hacen los malvados, ¿vivirán? Ninguna de las cosas justas que han hecho será recordada. Por la infidelidad de que son culpables y por los pecados que han cometido, morirán.
es.R: Pero supongamos que los buenos dejan de hacer lo correcto y empiezan a hacer el mal. Hacen las mismas cosas repugnantes que hacen los malvados. ¿Vivirán? ¡No! Ninguna de las cosas buenas que hicieron será recordada. Morirán porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fueron infieles y cometieron pecados.

decisions.choice: if the righteous turns away: past goodness is no protection
decisions.reason: The principle works both ways. A person who turns from righteousness to wickedness cannot rely on their past (compare 3:20). The chapter speaks of a person's settled direction, not of single faults.

decisions.choice: unfaithfulness: breach of trust against God
decisions.reason: As in 17:20, *ma'al* is a betrayal of what was owed to God.

source.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י שִׁמְעוּ־נָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲדַרְכִּי֙ לֹ֣א יִתָּכֵ֔ן הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you say, Not right is the way of [the] Lord. Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not right? Is it not your ways [that] are not right?

en.L: Yet you say, "Not right is the way of the Lord." Hear now, house of Israel: Is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} way not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?
en.B: Yet you say, "The Lord's way is not fair." Listen, house of Israel: Is it {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} way that is not fair? Is it not your ways that are unfair?
en.R: But you say, "What the Lord does is not fair." Listen, people of Israel. Is what I do unfair? No, it is what you do that is unfair!

fr.L: Et vous dites : « La voie du Seigneur n’est pas droite. » Écoutez donc, maison d’Israël : Est-ce {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voie qui n’est pas droite ? N’est-ce pas vos voies qui ne sont pas droites ?
fr.B: Et vous dites : « La manière d’agir du Seigneur n’est pas juste. » Écoutez, maison d’Israël : Est-ce {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} manière d’agir qui n’est pas juste ? N’est-ce pas plutôt la vôtre qui est injuste ?
fr.R: Mais vous dites : « Ce que fait le Seigneur n’est pas juste. » Écoutez, peuple d’Israël. Est-ce que ce que je fais est injuste ? Non, c’est ce que vous faites qui est injuste !

ko.L: 그런데 너희는 "주님의 길이 공평하지 않다." 하고 말한다. 이스라엘 집아, 이제 들어라. 내 길이 공평하지 않으냐? 공평하지 않은 것은 너희 길이 아니냐?
ko.B: 그런데도 너희는 "주님의 길은 공평하지 않다." 하고 말한다. 이스라엘 집아, 들어라. 내 길이 공평하지 않단 말이냐? 공평하지 않은 것은 오히려 너희 길이 아니냐?
ko.R: 그런데도 너희는 "주님께서 하시는 일은 공평하지 않다." 하고 말한다. 이스라엘 백성아, 들어라. 내가 하는 일이 공평하지 않으냐? 아니다, 공평하지 않은 것은 너희가 하는 일이다!

es.L: Y {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «No es recto el camino del Señor». {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} ahora, casa de Israel: ¿No es recto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} camino? ¿No son más bien {{plural_you:sus caminos|vuestros caminos}} los que no son rectos?
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: «El proceder del Señor no es justo». {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, casa de Israel: ¿Es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} proceder el que no es justo? ¿No es más bien {{plural_you:su proceder|vuestro proceder}} el que es injusto?
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: «Lo que hace el Señor no es justo». {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}, pueblo de Israel. ¿Es injusto lo que yo hago? ¡No, lo que {{plural_you:ustedes hacen|vosotros hacéis}} es lo injusto!

decisions.choice: not right: not fair, not measured by a just standard
decisions.reason: The verb means to be weighed or measured. The people say that the LORD's dealings do not measure up; the LORD answers that their own do not.

decisions.choice: What the Lord does
decisions.reason: Readable says what "way" means here: the LORD's dealings. "Lord" here translates *Adonai*.

decisions.choice: "주님" for Adonai in the people's complaint, with -시- at R ("주님께서 하시는 일")
decisions.reason: Adonai alone is 주님 (term sheet); the people speak about God, so R gives him the honorific, while God answers about himself with 내 길 and no -시-.

source.text: בְּשׁוּב־צַדִּ֧יק מִצִּדְקָת֛וֹ וְעָ֥שָׂה עָ֖וֶל וּמֵ֣ת עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם בְּעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יָמֽוּת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice and dies for them, for his injustice that he has done he will die.

en.L: When a righteous [person] turns away from his righteousness and does injustice, and dies for them, for his injustice that he has done he will die.
en.B: If righteous people turn away from their righteousness and do wrong, they will die for it; because of the wrong they have done, they will die.
en.R: If good people stop doing what is right and start doing wrong, they will die. They will die because of the wrong things they have done.

fr.L: Quand le juste se détourne de sa justice et commet l’injustice, et qu’il meurt à cause d’elles, c’est à cause de son injustice qu’il a commise qu’il mourra.
fr.B: Si le juste se détourne de sa justice et fait le mal, il en mourra ; c’est à cause du mal qu’il a fait qu’il mourra.
fr.R: Si celui qui est bon arrête de faire ce qui est juste et commence à faire le mal, il mourra. Il mourra à cause du mal qu’il a fait.

ko.L: 의인이 자기의 의에서 돌이켜 불의를 행하고 그 때문에 죽는다면, 그가 행한 불의 때문에 죽는 것이다.
ko.B: 의인이 자기의 의에서 돌이켜 악을 행하면 그 때문에 죽을 것이다. 그가 저지른 악 때문에 죽는 것이다.
ko.R: 착한 사람이 옳은 일을 그만두고 악한 일을 하기 시작하면 그는 죽을 것이다. 그가 한 악한 일 때문에 죽는 것이다.

es.L: Cuando el justo se aparta de su justicia y hace injusticia, y muere por ello, por la injusticia que hizo morirá.
es.B: Si los justos se apartan de su justicia y hacen el mal, morirán por ello; por el mal que han hecho, morirán.
es.R: Si los buenos dejan de hacer lo correcto y empiezan a hacer el mal, morirán. Morirán por el mal que han hecho.

decisions.choice: and dies for them: dies because of these wrongs
decisions.reason: "Them" refers to the wrongs he has done. The verse restates verse 24 as the LORD's answer to the charge of verse 25.

source.text: וּבְשׁ֣וּב רָשָׁ֗ע מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה ה֖וּא אֶת־נַפְשׁ֥וֹ יְחַיֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And when the wicked turns from his wickedness that he has done, and does justice and righteousness, he will keep his soul alive.

en.L: And when a wicked [person] turns away from his wickedness that he has done and does justice and righteousness, he will keep his soul alive.
en.B: And if wicked people turn away from the wickedness they have committed and do what is just and right, they will save their lives.
en.R: And if evil people stop doing evil and start doing what is fair and right, they will save their lives.

fr.L: Et quand le méchant se détourne de sa méchanceté qu’il a commise et pratique le droit et la justice, il gardera son âme en vie.
fr.B: Et si le méchant se détourne de la méchanceté qu’il a commise et pratique le droit et la justice, il sauvera sa vie.
fr.R: Et si le méchant arrête de faire le mal et commence à faire ce qui est équitable et juste, il sauvera sa vie.

ko.L: 그리고 악인이 자기가 저지른 악에서 돌이켜 정의와 의를 행하면, 그는 자기 영혼을 살릴 것이다.
ko.B: 악인이라도 자기가 저지른 악에서 돌이켜 정의와 의를 행하면, 자기 목숨을 건질 것이다.
ko.R: 악한 사람이라도 악한 일을 그만두고 공정하고 옳은 일을 하기 시작하면, 자기 목숨을 건질 것이다.

es.L: Y cuando el malvado se aparta de la maldad que hizo y practica el derecho y la justicia, conservará la vida de su alma.
es.B: Y si los malvados se apartan de la maldad que han cometido y hacen lo que es justo y recto, salvarán su vida.
es.R: Y si los malvados dejan de hacer el mal y empiezan a hacer lo que es justo y correcto, salvarán su vida.

decisions.choice: his soul: his life
decisions.reason: Here *nefesh* means "life": he will keep himself alive.

source.text: וַיִּרְאֶ֣ה וַיָּ֔שָׁב מִכָּל־פְּשָׁעָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה חָי֥וֹ יִחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he considered and turned from all his transgressions that he had done; he will surely live; he will not die.

en.L: Because he considered and turned away from all his transgressions that he had committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
en.B: Because they thought it over and turned away from all the rebellious acts they had committed, they will surely live; they will not die.
en.R: They thought about what they were doing, and they stopped sinning. So they will certainly live. They will not die.

fr.L: Parce qu’il a réfléchi et s’est détourné de toutes ses transgressions qu’il avait commises, il vivra certainement ; il ne mourra pas.
fr.B: Parce qu’il a réfléchi et s’est détourné de tous les actes de rébellion qu’il avait commis, il vivra certainement ; il ne mourra pas.
fr.R: Il a réfléchi à ce qu’il faisait, et il a arrêté de pécher. Alors il vivra, c’est certain. Il ne mourra pas.

ko.L: 그가 깨닫고 자기가 저지른 모든 반역에서 돌이켰으므로, 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 그는 죽지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 깊이 생각하고 자기가 저지른 모든 반역에서 돌이켰으니, 반드시 살 것이다. 죽지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 자기가 하던 일을 곰곰이 생각하고 죄짓기를 그만두었다. 그러니 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 죽지 않을 것이다.

es.L: Porque reflexionó y se apartó de todas las transgresiones que había cometido, ciertamente vivirá; no morirá.
es.B: Porque lo pensaron bien y se apartaron de todos los delitos que habían cometido, ciertamente vivirán; no morirán.
es.R: Pensaron en lo que estaban haciendo y dejaron de pecar. Por eso ciertamente vivirán. No morirán.

decisions.choice: he considered: he saw what he was doing and took it to heart
decisions.reason: The verb "see" here means to look at one's life and recognize the truth about it, as the grandson did in verse 14.

source.text: וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י הַדְּרָכַ֞י לֹ֤א יִתָּֽכְנּוּ֙בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And says the house of Israel, Not right is the way of [the] Lord. My ways, are they not right, house of Israel? Is it not your ways [that] are not right?

en.L: But the house of Israel says, "Not right is the way of the Lord." Are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways not right, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not right?
en.B: Yet the house of Israel says, "The Lord's way is not fair." Are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways unfair, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unfair?
en.R: But the people of Israel say, "What the Lord does is not fair." People of Israel, is what I do unfair? No, it is what you do that is unfair!

fr.L: Et la maison d’Israël dit : « La voie du Seigneur n’est pas droite. » Sont-ce {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} voies qui ne sont pas droites, maison d’Israël ? N’est-ce pas vos voies qui ne sont pas droites ?
fr.B: Et la maison d’Israël dit : « La manière d’agir du Seigneur n’est pas juste. » Est-ce {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} manière d’agir qui est injuste, maison d’Israël ? N’est-ce pas plutôt la vôtre qui est injuste ?
fr.R: Mais le peuple d’Israël dit : « Ce que fait le Seigneur n’est pas juste. » Peuple d’Israël, est-ce que ce que je fais est injuste ? Non, c’est ce que vous faites qui est injuste !

ko.L: 그런데 이스라엘 집은 "주님의 길이 공평하지 않다." 하고 말한다. 이스라엘 집아, 내 길이 공평하지 않으냐? 공평하지 않은 것은 너희 길이 아니냐?
ko.B: 그런데도 이스라엘 집은 "주님의 길은 공평하지 않다." 하고 말한다. 이스라엘 집아, 내 길이 공평하지 않단 말이냐? 공평하지 않은 것은 오히려 너희 길이 아니냐?
ko.R: 그런데도 이스라엘 백성은 "주님께서 하시는 일은 공평하지 않다." 하고 말한다. 이스라엘 백성아, 내가 하는 일이 공평하지 않으냐? 아니다, 공평하지 않은 것은 너희가 하는 일이다!

es.L: Pero la casa de Israel dice: «No es recto el camino del Señor». ¿No son rectos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos, casa de Israel? ¿No son más bien {{plural_you:sus caminos|vuestros caminos}} los que no son rectos?
es.B: Sin embargo, la casa de Israel dice: «El proceder del Señor no es justo». ¿Es injusto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} proceder, casa de Israel? ¿No es más bien {{plural_you:su proceder|vuestro proceder}} el que es injusto?
es.R: Pero el pueblo de Israel dice: «Lo que hace el Señor no es justo». Pueblo de Israel, ¿es injusto lo que yo hago? ¡No, lo que {{plural_you:ustedes hacen|vosotros hacéis}} es lo injusto!

decisions.choice: the same charge and answer as verse 25
decisions.reason: The repetition frames the chapter's last appeal (verses 30-32).

source.text: לָכֵן֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֜יו אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ט אֶתְכֶם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה שׁ֤וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ מִכָּל־פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם לְמִכְשׁ֖וֹל עָוֺֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore each according to his ways I will judge you, house of Israel, declares [the] Lord Yahweh. Turn and turn away from all your transgressions, so that it will not become to you a stumbling block of iniquity.

en.L: Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each according to his ways, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. Turn, and turn away from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not be a stumbling block for you.
en.B: Therefore, house of Israel, I will judge each of you according to your ways, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. Repent and turn away from all your rebellious acts, so that your guilt will not bring you down.
en.R: So, people of Israel, I will judge each of you by what you have done, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. Turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! Turn away from all your sins, so that your sin will not destroy you.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je vous jugerai, maison d’Israël, chacun selon ses voies, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Revenez, et détournez-vous de toutes vos transgressions, afin que l’iniquité ne soit pas pour vous une pierre d’achoppement.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, maison d’Israël, je jugerai chacun de vous selon sa conduite, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Revenez et détournez-vous de toutes vos rébellions, afin que votre faute ne cause pas votre chute.
fr.R: Alors, peuple d’Israël, je jugerai chacun de vous d’après ce qu’il a fait, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ! Détournez-vous de tous vos péchés, pour que votre péché ne cause pas votre perte.

ko.L: 그러므로 이스라엘 집아, 내가 너희를 각 사람의 길대로 심판하겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다. 돌아오너라. 너희의 모든 반역에서 돌아서라. 그러면 죄악이 너희에게 걸림돌이 되지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 이스라엘 집아, 내가 너희 각 사람을 그 행실대로 심판하겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 돌아오너라! 너희의 모든 반역에서 돌아서라. 그러면 죄가 너희를 넘어뜨리지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러니 이스라엘 백성아, 내가 너희 각 사람을 그가 한 일대로 심판하겠다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 마음을 돌이켜 나에게 돌아오너라! 너희의 모든 죄를 버려라. 그래야 그 죄가 너희를 망하게 하지 않을 것이다.

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgaré, casa de Israel, a cada uno según sus caminos, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} y {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de todas {{plural_you:sus transgresiones|vuestras transgresiones}}, para que la iniquidad no {{plural_you:les|os}} sea tropiezo.
es.B: Por eso, casa de Israel, {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgaré a cada uno según su proceder, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} y {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de todos {{plural_you:sus delitos|vuestros delitos}}, para que la culpa no {{plural_you:los haga caer|os haga caer}}.
es.R: Por eso, pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:los|os}} juzgaré a cada uno por lo que haya hecho, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¡{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}! {{plural_you:Apártense de todos sus pecados|Apartaos de todos vuestros pecados}}, para que el pecado no {{plural_you:los|os}} destruya.

decisions.choice: turn and turn away: repent, change direction
decisions.reason: The verb *shuv* means to turn around. The second form means to turn oneself (or others) away from sin. Together they call for a full change of life.

decisions.choice: a stumbling block of iniquity: something that makes them fall into guilt and judgment
decisions.reason: Ezekiel uses the phrase for what causes Israel to fall (7:19; 14:3-4).

decisions.choice: Turn back to me
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that turning means coming back to the LORD, which the call implies.

decisions.choice: "{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}}" (L, B); "{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a mí" (R)
decisions.reason: Shuv as at 14:6: "volver", never "arrepentirse".

source.text: הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶת־כָּל־פִּשְׁעֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֣ם בָּ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לֵ֥ב חָדָ֖שׁ וְר֣וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלָ֥מָּה תָמֻ֖תוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Cast away from you all your transgressions which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why will you die, house of Israel?

en.L: Cast away from you all your transgressions by which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why will you die, house of Israel?
en.B: Throw away all the rebellious acts you have committed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why would you die, house of Israel?
en.R: Get rid of all the sins you have committed. Get a new heart and a new spirit. People of Israel, why should you die?

fr.L: Rejetez loin de vous toutes vos transgressions par lesquelles vous avez transgressé, et faites-vous un cœur nouveau et un esprit nouveau ; et pourquoi mourriez-vous, maison d’Israël ?
fr.B: Rejetez loin de vous toutes les rébellions que vous avez commises, et faites-vous un cœur nouveau et un esprit nouveau. Pourquoi voudriez-vous mourir, maison d’Israël ?
fr.R: Débarrassez-vous de tous les péchés que vous avez commis. Faites-vous un cœur nouveau et un esprit nouveau. Peuple d’Israël, pourquoi devriez-vous mourir ?

ko.L: 너희가 저지른 모든 반역을 너희에게서 던져 버리고, 너희를 위하여 새 마음과 새 영을 만들어라. 이스라엘 집아, 너희가 어찌하여 죽으려고 하느냐?
ko.B: 너희가 저지른 모든 반역을 내던져 버리고, 새 마음과 새 영을 가져라. 이스라엘 집아, 너희가 어찌하여 죽으려 하느냐?
ko.R: 너희가 지은 모든 죄를 버려라. 새 마음과 새 영을 가져라. 이스라엘 백성아, 너희가 왜 죽으려고 하느냐?

es.B: {{plural_you:Desháganse de todos los delitos que han cometido|Deshaceos de todos los delitos que habéis cometido}}, y {{plural_you:háganse|haceos}} un corazón nuevo y un espíritu nuevo. ¿Por qué {{plural_you:habrían de morir|habríais de morir}}, casa de Israel?
es.R: {{plural_you:Desháganse de todos los pecados que han cometido|Deshaceos de todos los pecados que habéis cometido}}. {{plural_you:Consíganse|Conseguíos}} un corazón nuevo y un espíritu nuevo. Pueblo de Israel, ¿por qué {{plural_you:han de morir|habéis de morir}}?

decisions.choice: make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit: a command that the LORD elsewhere promises to fulfill
decisions.reason: Here the people are told to make a new heart and spirit; in 11:19 and 36:26 the LORD promises to give them. The call and the promise belong together: the LORD commands what he himself makes possible.

decisions.choice: spirit: the inner life, the will and attitude
decisions.reason: *Ruach* here is the human spirit, not the Spirit of God that enters Ezekiel (see the note at 2:2), so it is lowercase.

decisions.choice: have transgressed (L); have committed (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb *pasha'* follows the settled wording ("transgress" / "rebel" / "sin"), with the object already naming the sins.

decisions.choice: "새 마음과 새 영" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for 11:19 and 36:26, so the command here and the promise there read alike.

records.literal_gloss: For not I take pleasure in [the] death of the one dying, declares [the] Lord Yahweh. So turn and live!

en.L: For I take no pleasure in the death of the one who dies, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. So turn, and live!
en.B: The death of anyone gives {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} no pleasure, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. So turn back and live!
en.R: I do not want anyone to die, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}. So turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and live!

fr.L: Car je ne prends pas plaisir à la mort de celui qui meurt, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Revenez donc, et vivez !
fr.B: La mort de qui que ce soit ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fait pas plaisir, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Revenez donc, et vivez !
fr.R: Je ne veux la mort de personne, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Alors revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et vivez !

ko.L: 나는 죽는 자의 죽음을 기뻐하지 않는다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그러니 돌아와서 살아라!
ko.B: 나는 누구의 죽음도 기뻐하지 않는다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 그러니 돌아와서 살아라!
ko.R: 나는 아무도 죽기를 바라지 않는다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 그러니 나에게 돌아와서 살아라!

es.L: Porque no me complazco en la muerte del que muere, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¡{{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}}, pues, y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}}!
es.B: La muerte de nadie {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} causa placer, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¡Así que {{plural_you:vuélvanse|volveos}} y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}}!
es.R: Yo no quiero que nadie muera, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. ¡Así que {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}}!

decisions.choice: I take no pleasure in the death of anyone: verse 23 again
decisions.reason: The chapter ends as verse 23 does, with the LORD's desire that people live, and an invitation.
